claims.claim_text: As of March 31, 2024 Lineage's warehousing portfolio encompassed 463 temperature-controlled warehouses with ~81.9M sq ft, 2.9B cubic feet and 9.8M pallet positions; 312 in North America, 82 in Europe, 88 in Asia-Pacific.
claims.subject: Lineage, Inc. (Lineage Logistics)
claims.source_quote: our warehousing portfolio encompassed 463 warehouses ... contained approximately 81.9 million square feet, 2.9 billion cubic feet and 9.8 million pallet positions ... 312 in North America, 82 in Europe and 88 in Asia-Pacific.

claims.claim_text: Lineage's cold-storage warehouses use anhydrous-ammonia industrial refrigeration with EPA/OSHA risk-management programs in place across jurisdictions where it operates.
claims.subject: Lineage warehouses
claims.source_quote: significant costs under environmental laws relating to the presence and management of asbestos, anhydrous ammonia and other chemicals ... risk management programs required by ... the EPA and other regulatory agencies

claims.claim_text: Lineage is the largest temperature-controlled warehousing company globally and has the largest automated temperature-controlled portfolio with 81 automated facilities (24 fully, 57 semi-automated).
claims.subject: Lineage, Inc.
claims.object_value: world's largest cold-storage REIT; 81 automated facilities
claims.source_quote: We are the largest temperature-controlled warehousing company globally ... the largest automated temperature-controlled portfolio with 81 automated facilities, 24 of which are fully automated and 57 of which are semi-automated.

claims.claim_text: Lineage serves more than 13,000 customers including household-name food retailers, manufacturers, processors and food-service distributors; no single customer accounted for more than 3.3% of revenue (TTM 3/31/2024); top 25 customers = ~32% of revenue; over 60% of top-25 revenue from investment-grade-rated companies.
claims.subject: Lineage customer base
claims.source_quote: currently serve more than 13,000 customers that include household names ... no single customer accounted for more than 3.3% of our revenues ... Approximately 32.0% of our total revenue ... came from our top 25 customers ... over 60% of the revenue generated from our top 25 customers is from companies with at least one investment grade rating

claims.claim_text: Through solar installations at its facilities Lineage is the fifth-largest corporate producer in the U.S., and second-largest REIT producer, of on-site solar and battery capacity (per the 2022 SEIA Solar Means Business Report).
claims.subject: Lineage, Inc.
claims.source_quote: Through solar installations at our facilities, we are the fifth-largest corporate producer in the United States, and the second-largest REIT producer, of on-site solar and battery capacity per the 2022 Solar Means Business Report

claims.claim_text: Lineage generated $5.3 billion of revenue and a $162.8 million net loss for the twelve months ended March 31, 2024, with total debt and debt-like obligations of ~$10.7B (historical) and significant CMBS/term-loan maturities.
claims.subject: Lineage, Inc.
claims.source_quote: we generated $5.3 billion of revenue, $162.8 million of net loss, $1.8 billion of NOI and $1.3 billion of Adjusted EBITDA
